linear_attention.peak_basis: Four participating p300c ASICs;120 physical cores/ASIC,1.35GHz,4096 LoFi FLOP/cycle/core;512GB/s/ASIC. Whole-layer maximum per-device firmware envelope includes attention, norms, CCL, movement and gaps.
linear_attention.flops_assumptions: Useful dense matmul work and logical causal attention/recurrence/scalar work; no MoE and no padding counted useful. Mixed BF16 activations, BFP4/LoFi projections, FP32/HiFi4 sensitive recurrence/attention: denominator is chip LoFi peak, not an achievable mixed-kernel ceiling.
linear_attention.traffic_assumptions: BFP4 tile storage576 bytes/1024 elements, actual local weight padding, compulsory decode projection reads; recurrent/history read+write or4224 prefix KV reads+one token write including BFP8 headers; replicated residual input/output. Excludes intermediate spills, rereads, CCL staging and small constants. Lower-bound estimate, not bus counters.

workload.decode_measurement: Final warmed step at context4224 after128 advancing decode steps

single_chip_baseline.peak_basis: One p300c Blackhole ASIC:120 physical cores,1.35GHz,4096 FLOP/cycle/core LoFi theoretical peak;512GB/s GDDR6. Runtime storage grid110 cores; matmul reader workers16. No multi-device aggregation.
single_chip_baseline.traffic_assumptions: Estimated compulsory physical traffic: BFP4 weights including exponent headers and reader padding read once; BF16 residual input/output; FP32 recurrent and row-major BF16 convolution state read/write, or BFP8 prefix KV read plus token write. Excludes intermediate spills, repeated reads and small constants: lower bound, not bus counters.
single_chip_baseline.flops_assumptions: Useful dense matmul work and logical causal attention/recurrence/scalar work; no MoE and no padding counted useful. Mixed BF16 activations, BFP4/LoFi projections, FP32/HiFi4 sensitive recurrence/attention: denominator is chip LoFi peak, not an achievable mixed-kernel ceiling.
single_chip_baseline.source: single-layer Tracy; complete firmware timestamp envelope including all operations and internal gaps
